limitations: arXiv /abs, /html, Hugging Face, Semantic Scholar, OpenReview, ACL, IEEE, Nature, YouTube/Bilibili and vendor blogs are blocked (403/407/000). The only working paper route was the arXiv export API via web_fetch, used for 11 abstracts. NO paper full text was read; for all other papers, evidence is the upstream catalog row plus linked GitHub repo metadata/README.

Where a code repository exists, evidence is GitHub API metadata (license, stars, last push, archived) and the README opening paragraph; READMEs of 15 key tools were additionally read manually (GEPA, DSPy, TextGrad, ACE, SkillOpt, Trace, DGM, Reflexion, Hyperagents, PluginRSI, ShinkaEvolve, Live-SWE-agent, Dynamic Cheatsheet, Prime Agent, Harness Handbook).

The Auditing Self-Improving AI Systems blog and upstream README_AGENT.md were read directly; audit-cited issues (gepa-ai/gepa#381, microsoft/SkillOpt#67, NousResearch/hermes-agent-self-evolution#141) were confirmed to exist via GitHub API. microsoft/SkillOpt#67 is closed and its title (verifier-discipline stress test) differs from the blog's description - treat the blog's counterexample framing as third-party, non-peer-reviewed.

Every row now has an individual per-entry reason (basis=individual or individual-catalog-level) grounded in title, upstream catalog row and linked repo README; 'individual-catalog-level' means the paper itself was not read. Dispositions are judgment calls and should be revisited before adoption.
Upstream data oddities are flagged per entry in upstream_notes (duplicate rows, shared code links, suspected mislinks). Several 2026 arXiv IDs could not be verified.
No third-party code was installed or run; no local code or secrets were sent externally.

Other abstracts were not retrieved in this review; failed /abs and /html routes do not establish that every export-API abstract is unavailable. SIA-132 links arXiv 2305.00833, which appears to be a different paper (Self-Notes) from Dynamic Cheatsheet (2504.07952). Further primary-source review remains incomplete.

recommendations.title: Adopt a propose->evaluate->gate loop over static prompts, GEPA/SkillOpt/ACE as design sources
recommendations.detail: Optimize agents/*.md, skills/ and tools/ descriptions as text parameters (image/AGENTS.md is not an optimizer target in the local implementation). Use GEPA (MIT, Pareto reflective evolution) as an out-of-band dev-host optimizer or reimplement its accept/reject core in stdlib Python; borrow SkillOpt's validation-gated update and best-artifact output; borrow ACE's Generator/Reflector/Curator delta updates for a curated playbook section. RECOMMENDATION (not what is implemented): outputs should be a reviewable diff/PR with no in-cluster self-edit. IMPLEMENTED locally instead: opt-in --promote that atomically rewrites one Markdown target after the gate passes.
recommendations.local_status: Partially realized conceptually by scripts/12-self-improve.py (gate+holdout+promote); no upstream package; no Pareto/DSPy.

recommendations.title: Make the gate stricter than the published tools
recommendations.detail: Third-party audit (page read) reports no-op optimizers, mean-only gates accepting regressions, held-out leakage and missing admission ledgers (gepa-ai/gepa#381 open; microsoft/SkillOpt#67 closed). Require: per-task non-regression, held-out split the optimizer never sees, immutable evaluator/gate files outside the optimizer's write scope, negative-control probes, and an append-only admission ledger (JSONL) recording accept/reject reasons.
